request_description: A web application architecture consisting of an Angular frontend and a Spring Boot backend. The Angular frontend runs on an Nginx web server hosted on a virtual machine, while the Spring Boot backend runs on a Tomcat web server hosted on another virtual machine. The backend connects to a PostgreSQL DBMS managing a PostgreSQL database, both hosted on the same virtual machine as the backend. The frontend connects to the backend for data interaction.
